cinematic_inference.protagonist_occupation: Owner-Operator of a Floral Studio for Weddings & Events
cinematic_inference.body_design: 5'5" (165 cm), medium build with practical, capable hands; measured, slightly stooped posture; short, neatly trimmed nails; visible veins on forearms.
cinematic_inference.ethnicity_design: White, Midwestern American of mixed Northern European ancestry (porcelain to light-olive skin, subtle freckling on forearms).
cinematic_inference.hair_design: Salt-and-pepper hair cut to a chin-length bob with gentle waves, usually pulled into a loose low twist or clipped back with a single tortoiseshell barrette while working.
cinematic_inference.wardrobe_design: Functional, quietly conservative: durable linen-blend shirts and soft cardigans in muted florals or earth tones, straight-cut cotton trousers or mid-rise jeans, sensible low-heeled leather loafers or rubber-soled clogs for studio hours; an indigo denim apron with deep pockets and a lightweight trench coat for deliveries and market runs. Simple small stud earrings and a plain signet or non-marital decorative ring on her right hand.
cinematic_inference.casting_rationale: A woman in her 50s, methodical and reserved, suits a tactile, hands-on small-business role that balances steady work rhythms with intimate client moments. The chosen physical and wardrobe details provide a visually specific, production-ready character who reads as dependable, quietly traditional, and comfortable moving between studio labor and gentle social exchanges.

director_profile.social_dynamics: Daily collaboration with one reliable part-time assistant (late 20s–30s) and occasional freelance installers; respectful, gently hierarchical relationships with local vendors (farmers, wholesalers) and venue managers; client interactions are intimate and often emotionally charged—she is professional, politely guarded, and reveals warmth slowly during consultations.
director_profile.professional_vibe: A carefully run, modestly scaled creative business: slow, meticulous prep at a sunlit worktable; intense, logistical installs at venues; early-morning market runs and deliveries. Reputation built on dependability, tasteful restraint, and hands-on craft.
director_profile.visual_vibe: Warm, tactile palette: weathered wooden worktables, galvanized buckets, ribbon spools, muted floral fabrics, soft natural light, and worn tools; contrasts between quiet studio stillness and the kinetic, ladder-and-ribbon choreography of event installs.
credible_worlds: Sunlit neighborhood floral studio with a large central worktable, shelving of glass vases, buckets of stems, and a small walk-in cooler

Residential doorstep deliveries and short suburban drives with a cargo van packed with arrangements
Home kitchen in a modest small-town house where she irons ribbons, balances books, and answers client calls
director_profile.parallel_story_rule: Keep her spiritual and community ties as background texture in off-duty life; do not make a private religious or family institution her employer or central plot mechanic—focus drama around the studio, clients, vendors, and installations instead.

occupation_selection.job_title: Owner-Operator of a Floral Studio for Weddings & Events
occupation_selection.rationale: This choice gives the strongest cinematic range while staying credible for a reflective, reserved woman in her 50s. The work is hands-on and methodical—practical skills (conditioning stems, wiring boutonnieres, large installations) suit her deliberate, dependable manner—yet it also opens to gentle interpersonal moments: quiet consultations, mentoring a part-time assistant, and tender exchanges with clients during emotionally significant events. Visually, the studio and pickup/delivery sites create varied, active settings (sunlit worktable, buckets and ribbons, behind-the-scenes venue installs, early-morning market runs) without relying on bureaucratic scenes. It supports shifting tempos—slow, careful prep; intense, collaborative installs; brief warm client interactions—matching her guarded-but-warm interpersonal style and modest economic independence as a small-business owner.
